key_patterns: Objects are defined in EditorObjects.ts using mergeGroup(). Collision is generated per-mesh in addColliders() in PlaytestMode.ts. Door systems use 3D distanceTo for proximity checks. Terrain system uses fixed geometry with importData only updating vertex data.
directory_structure: JailBreak-1.2/src/editor/ - editor code (MapEditor, PlaytestMode, EditorObjects). JailBreak-1.2/src/game/ - game systems (DoorSystem, GarageDoorSystem, RentalDoorSystem, TerrainSystem). JailBreak-1.2/src/components/ - React UI components. JailBreak-1.2/src/utils/ - utilities (mergeGroup).
